title: Path of Exile 2 Build File
description: JSON Schema for .build files consumed by the Path of Exile 2 in-game Build Planner (added Patch 0.5). Files live in 'Documents/My Games/Path of Exile 2/BuildPlanner' and must end in '.build'. Based on the community-maintained schema at github.com/chesler410/poe2-build-forge (which cites pathofexile.com/developer/docs/game as its source), with two corrections found by cross-checking a real, game-accepted file: 'Trinket1' added to the inventory_id enum (charm slots — not just 'Charm1'), and AdditionalText's markup tags corrected to the short codes actually used (<b>, <i>, <s>, <m>) rather than full words.

link.description: Source URL for the build (e.g. the build guide it was exported from). Optional.

ascendancy.description: Ascendancy class id, e.g. 'Mercenary3', 'Witch1'. See data/index/passives.json's `classes[].ascendancies[].id` for the full current list. Empty/omitted means no ascendancy hint.

passives.description: Passive tree allocations, in the order the player should take them. Each entry is either a string (shorthand for just the id) or a BuildPassive object.

oneOf.description: Shorthand: a PassiveSkills table id with no level interval or additional text.

skills.description: Active skill gems. Each entry is either a string (shorthand) or a BuildSkill object with optional support gems.

oneOf.description: Shorthand: a BaseItemTypes table id for a skill gem.

inventory_slots.description: Inventory slot hints shown when hovering that slot in the character panel. Does not equip actual items.

LevelInterval.description: Inclusive character-level range [min, max]. PoE2's level cap is 100.

AdditionalText.description:
Hover/tooltip text shown in-game. Confirmed markup from a real game-accepted file: <b>{text} bold, <i>{text} italics, <s>{text} default/secondary body text, <m>{text} an accent/highlight colour (exact colour unconfirmed), named colours like <red>{text}/<green>{text}, and arbitrary RGB via <rgb(r, g, b)>{text}. Tags nest. Use 
 or 
 for newlines (real files use 
).

id.description: A PassiveSkills table id, e.g. 'projectiles18', 'AscendancyMercenary3Notable1_', 'jewel_slot1975'. Look these up by display name via src/passives.js — do not guess: many ids carry irregular trailing underscores/suffixes with no predictable pattern.

weapon_set.description: Weapon-set this passive applies to (PoE2 supports two: 1 or 2). Used for passives near a weapon-swap jewel socket that only make sense for one of the two loadouts.

unique_name.description: Optional display label for this passive in the build's context (not the node's canonical name).

id.description: A BaseItemTypes id for an active skill gem, e.g. 'Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlameblast'.

support_skills.description: Recommended support gems linked to this skill. Order is informational only.

oneOf.description: Shorthand: a BaseItemTypes id for a support gem.

id.description: A BaseItemTypes id for a support gem, e.g. 'Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBurgeonTwo'. Note the id path is inconsistently 'Gem' vs 'Gems' across the real data — never construct this by formula, always look it up.

BuildItem.description: A hint attached to an inventory slot.

inventory_id.description: Inventory slot identifier. Weapons: 'Weapon1' (set I), 'Weapon2' (swap set). Armour: 'Helm1', 'BodyArmour1', 'Gloves1', 'Boots1'. Jewellery: 'Amulet1', 'Belt1', 'Ring1', 'Ring2' (rings are the only category that increments). 'Charm1' for every charm slot AND/OR 'Trinket1' — a real game-accepted file uses 'Trinket1' for charm-type slots, distinguished by slot_x, so treat 'Charm1' as possibly a renamed/legacy alias of 'Trinket1' rather than a separate slot type; confirm which your patch expects before relying on either. 'Flask1' for every flask slot, distinguished by slot_x. No 'Offhand' — the game never uses it.

slot_x.description: X coordinate within the inventory slot's grid (distinguishes e.g. multiple charms/flasks).

slot_y.description: Y coordinate within the inventory slot's grid.

unique_name.description: A unique item's plain display name (e.g. 'Ghostmarch', 'Darkness Enthroned') — not an internal id. Cross-check against data/index/uniques.json.
